diagnosis: The Lambda handler dispatches an MQTT door unlock payload to vehicle vin retrieved from pathParameters without checking whether the authenticated driver (Cognito claims) is registered as the vehicle owner or authorized driver. Anyone can unlock arbitrary cars.
